'''Nace''' was a [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]]<ref name="Red Harvest" /> of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]<ref name="Empire" /> who trained on the [[Sith academy|academy]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Odacer-Faustin]] in [[3645 BBY]]. Nace studied [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] technique under [[Sith Blademaster]] [[Shak'Weth]], and was considered proficient in the art by fellow student [[Wim Nickter]]. When [[Rance Lussk]], one of the most talented acolytes in attendance at the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|academy]], decided to issue a challenge to one of his classmates, Nickter believed that Nace was a possible choice, as the two duelists had comparable skill. Ultimately, Lussk chose Nickter, and Nace watched with the rest of his [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueling]] group as Rance brutally and easily defeated Nickter. Nace was a capable lightsaber duelist, in a league of talent that also included fellow Sith-in-training [[Jura Ostrogoth]], [[Scopique]], Rance Lussk, and [[Mnah Ra'at]].<ref name="Red Harvest" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nace appeared in the [[2010]] novel [[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']], written by [[Joe Schreiber]].<ref name="Red Harvest" />
